name: cctv
short: Two live Pixel Agents office pages on one listener.
description: Owns the Discord guild projection, registered-agent editor projection, WebSocket listener, Dashboard pages, display policy, and activity clear timing for both CCTV views.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores per-server display settings only. While a server's office is enabled, its office web page (public, unlisted or members-only, per server) shows members' display names, characters, presence, rich presence and the text of new messages in channels everyone in the server can read, as they happen; the editor page, which anyone may watch, shows the registered agents' activity for requests from such channels. That is live Discord data held in memory and never persisted. The characters and seats it draws are stored in corridor's office-state store and deleted by pixelagents. Dashboard and Discord Activity sign-in tickets live in memory for one minute. The Activity's Discord sign-in token is passed through, never stored; which user a token belongs to is held in memory for five minutes.
install_msg: Install corridor and pixelagents too ([p]cog install pixel-agents-cogs corridor pixelagents); both load automatically. Starts an aiohttp HTTP/WebSocket listener (127.0.0.1:3210 by default; [p]cctv host/port) that serves the office webview to browsers. Setup: the browser views need AAA3A's Red Web Dashboard installed and set up (https://red-web-dashboard.readthedocs.io/en/latest/); every page (/third-party/cctv) is a Dashboard page. Then route /cctv/office/<server id>/ws and /cctv/editor/ws to the listener through a reverse proxy, set [p]cctv publicurl, then [p]cctv enable in a server. Offices are public by default ([p]cctv visibility); anyone who can reach the editor page can watch it, but only the bot owner signed in to the Dashboard can edit it ([p]cctv editors set opts in a corridor permission group). Showing offline members and presences needs the members and presences gateway intents. Character links point at Pixel Index's designer ([p]cctv designer). Optional, off until the bot owner sets it up: the offices can also open inside Discord as an Activity. That needs Activities turned on for the bot's application in Discord's Developer Portal with one URL mapping, /cctv/activity routed to the listener, and Red Web Dashboard's OAuth client secret, which the Activity's sign-in reuses; then [p]cctv activity enable (steps in cctv's README).
author: Tin Nguyen
